name: [Sigma] SSH Port-Forward (direct-tcpip) Request Through Honeypot
description:
The SSH client asked the honeypot to open a TCP connection to a third party
(a direct-tcpip channel, i.e. 'ssh -L' / -W style forwarding). Attackers
use this to proxy traffic, check their apparent egress IP, or reach STUN
and web endpoints through the compromised host. Cowrie logs the request and
does not relay it.
false_positives: Legitimate SSH port forwarding by an administrator (not applicable on a honeypot)
author: dram64
